name: SponsorBlock Segments
description: Turns SponsorBlock data into Jellyfin media segments, so sponsors, intros, recaps and self-promotion get a skip button. Reads the [SponsorBlock] chapters yt-dlp embeds and falls back to the SponsorBlock API for files without them. Every segment in a file is emitted, each category maps to a segment type you choose, and nothing is scanned until you opt a library, series or season in.
overview: Skip buttons for sponsors, intros and recaps in a YouTube library, from the SponsorBlock data already in your files.

versions.changelog: First release. Reads the [SponsorBlock] chapters yt-dlp embeds and turns every one of them into a Jellyfin media segment, falling back to the SponsorBlock API for files that carry none. Categories are matched on the whole chapter label rather than by substring, which is what stops a Preview/Recap chapter being filed as an advert - every one of these chapters is prefixed "[SponsorBlock]:", so a pattern written to catch sponsors matches all of them. Each of the ten categories maps to a segment type of your choosing, or to nothing at all, and scanning is an allowlist: until a library, series or season is opted in, the plugin produces no segments anywhere.
